nodes.description: Public string state variable storing the token name 'ZEVS FINANCE', set once in the constructor.
Public string state variable storing the token symbol 'ZEVS', set once in the constructor.
Public uint8 state variable storing token decimals (18), set once in the constructor.
Public uint256 state variable holding the total token supply minted to the deployer in the constructor.
Mapping(address => uint) holding every account's token balance; written by the constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) holding ERC20 allowances; written by approve and transferFrom.
Interface declaration of totalSupply(); no implementation provided in the interface contract.
Interface declaration of balanceOf(address); no implementation provided in the interface contract.
Interface declaration of allowance(address,address); no implementation provided in the interface contract.
Interface declaration of transfer(address,uint); no implementation provided in the interface contract.
Interface declaration of approve(address,uint); no implementation provided in the interface contract.
Interface declaration of transferFrom(address,address,uint); no implementation provided in the interface contract.
Internal safe addition helper: computes a + b and requires the result to be >= a to reject overflow.
Internal safe subtraction helper: requires b <= a, then computes a - b to reject underflow.
Internal safe multiplication helper: computes a * b and requires a == 0 or c / a == b to reject overflow.
Internal safe division helper: requires b > 0, then computes a / b.
Constructor that sets name, symbol, decimals and _totalSupply, then credits the whole supply to msg.sender and emits Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using a raw, unchecked subtraction that can underflow.
View returning balances[tokenOwner].
View returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval; no zero-first requirement (ERC20 approve race condition).
Debits msg.sender with safeSub and credits 'to' with safeAdd, then emits Transfer.
Debits 'from' with safeSub, decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] with safeSub and credits 'to' with safeAdd, then emits Transfer.
Caller-controlled address used as the trusted sender for balances, allowances and initial minting.
Raw unchecked subtraction (_totalSupply - balances[address(0)]) inside totalSupply, which bypasses SafeMath and can underflow/revert or wrap.
First uint parameter a of SafeMath.safeAdd.
Second uint parameter b of SafeMath.safeAdd.
First uint parameter a of SafeMath.safeSub.
Second uint parameter b of SafeMath.safeSub.
First uint parameter a of SafeMath.safeMul.
Second uint parameter b of SafeMath.safeMul.
First uint parameter a of SafeMath.safeDiv.
Second uint parameter b of SafeMath.safeDiv.
Address parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf, used as the balances mapping key.
Address parameter tokenOwner of allowance, used as the first allowed mapping key.
Address parameter spender of allowance, used as the second allowed mapping key.
Address parameter spender of approve, used as the allowed mapping key.
uint parameter tokens of approve, stored as the granted allowance.
Address parameter to of transfer, credited with the transferred tokens.
uint parameter tokens of transfer, subtracted from the sender and added to the recipient.
Address parameter from of transferFrom, debited via balances and allowed.
Address parameter to of transferFrom, credited with the transferred tokens.
uint parameter tokens of transferFrom, used for balance and allowance updates.
Return/local variable c in safeAdd holding the computed sum.
Return/local variable c in safeSub holding the computed difference.
Return/local variable c in safeMul holding the computed product.
Return/local variable c in safeDiv holding the computed quotient.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used by the constructor to credit the entire initial supply, so the caller controls who receives _totalSupply.
approve keys the allowance write on msg.sender, making the caller the authorizing account.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller determines which balance is reduced.
transferFrom spends the caller's allowance (allowed[from][msg.sender]), so msg.sender controls the spender side of the authorization.
Constructor writes the token name state variable.
Constructor writes the token symbol state variable.
Constructor writes the decimals state variable.
Constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed initial supply.
Constructor writes balances[msg.sender] = _totalSupply, minting the whole supply to the deployer.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply as the first operand of its return expression.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] as the subtracted operand.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner] and returns it.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender] and returns it.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens.
transfer updates balances[msg.sender] and balances[to] using safeSub/safeAdd.
transferFrom updates balances[from] and balances[to] using safeSub/safeAdd.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] with safeSub.
totalSupply performs a raw unchecked subtraction, matching the unsafe arithmetic operation.
_totalSupply is the minuend of the unchecked subtraction, so its value drives the underflow/integer bound issue.
balances[address(0)] is the subtrahend of the unchecked subtraction and can exceed _totalSupply, causing underflow.
transfer invokes SafeMath.safeSub to debit the sender.
transfer invokes SafeMath.safeAdd to credit the recipient.
transferFrom invokes SafeMath.safeSub for the from-balance and the allowance.
transferFrom invokes SafeMath.safeAdd to credit the recipient.
Parameter a feeds the addition inside safeAdd.
Parameter b feeds the addition inside safeAdd.
Parameter a feeds the subtraction inside safeSub.
Parameter b is compared against a and subtracted inside safeSub.
Parameter a feeds the multiplication inside safeMul.
Parameter b feeds the multiplication inside safeMul.
Parameter a feeds the division inside safeDiv.
Parameter b is required > 0 and used as divisor inside safeDiv.
Parameter tokenOwner is used as the balances key in balanceOf.
Parameter tokenOwner is used as the outer key in the allowance lookup.
Parameter spender is used as the inner key in the allowance lookup.
Parameter spender is the key whose allowance is granted by approve.
Parameter tokens is stored as the granted allowance value in approve.
Parameter to is the recipient credited by transfer.
Parameter tokens is the amount moved by transfer.
Parameter from is the account debited by transferFrom.
Parameter to is the recipient credited by transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is the amount moved by transferFrom.
Local c in safeAdd holds the arithmetic result returned to the caller.
Local c in safeSub holds the arithmetic result returned to the caller.
Local c in safeMul holds the arithmetic result returned to the caller.
Local c in safeDiv holds the arithmetic result returned to the caller.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter a of safeAdd is only meaningful as part of the safeAdd computation, so it is merged into the safeAdd core function.
Parameter b of safeAdd is only meaningful as part of the safeAdd computation, so it is merged into the safeAdd core function.
Parameter a of safeSub belongs to the safeSub arithmetic core function and is merged into it.
Parameter b of safeSub (the underflow bound operand) belongs to the safeSub core function and is merged into it.
Parameter a of safeMul belongs to the safeMul arithmetic core function and is merged into it.
Parameter b of safeMul belongs to the safeMul arithmetic core function and is merged into it.
Parameter a of safeDiv belongs to the safeDiv arithmetic core function and is merged into it.
Parameter b of safeDiv (divisor) belongs to the safeDiv core function and is merged into it.
tokenOwner only parameterizes the balanceOf state read and is merged into balanceOf.
tokenOwner only parameterizes the allowance lookup and is merged into allowance.
spender only parameterizes the allowance lookup and is merged into allowance.
The spender argument only parameterizes the allowance write in approve and is merged into approve.
The tokens argument is the amount written by approve, so it is merged into the approve core function.
The 'to' argument only parameterizes the credit performed by transfer and is merged into transfer.
The tokens argument is the amount moved by transfer, so it is merged into the transfer core function.
The 'from' argument only parameterizes the debit performed by transferFrom and is merged into transferFrom.
The 'to' argument only parameterizes the credit performed by transferFrom and is merged into transferFrom.
The tokens argument is the amount moved by transferFrom, so it is merged into the transferFrom core function.
Local result variable c exists only to hold the safeAdd output and is merged into safeAdd.
Local result variable c exists only to hold the safeSub output and is merged into safeSub.
Local result variable c exists only to hold the safeMul output and is merged into safeMul.
Local result variable c exists only to hold the safeDiv output and is merged into safeDiv.
